content: Named entity recognition (NER) BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 , BIBREF3 is the process by which we identify text spans which mention named entities, and to classify them into predefined categories such as person, location, organization etc. NER serves as the basis for a variety of natural language processing (NLP) applications such as relation extraction BIBREF4 , machine translation BIBREF5 , question answering BIBREF6 and knowledge base construction BIBREF7 . Although early NER systems have been successful in producing adequate recognition accuracy, they often require significant human effort in carefully designing rules or features.
